claim: P1 doorb ladder (freeze 9c2eccb0f583d044699f0454): the two-copy sealed-shadow protocol's delivered copy count vs the PROVEN single-copy lower bound, reported as r(n)=eps_del/eps_size per rung over >=3 rungs with intervals, no slope fit; falsifier r<0.8 at 10.4 sigma. Written by the register seat (Whisper C5097) at Creator GO general#22413; answers cite the F122 court record and the frozen registration, and every 'unknown' is a question for the code owner named beside it.

_rationale.structure_public: Sealed P drawn by the sealer seat under a hiding commitment (sha256(P|128-bit salt)); the WEIGHT is disclosed at unseal only, which narrows P-space to ~20.8% at n=16 (Ember general#19408) and is registered as a disclosure, not a break.
_rationale.baseline_is_simulation: The floor is the proven single-copy sample-complexity lower bound for estimating a sealed Pauli at delivered eps (F122 court, 3 seats) — cost-to-SOLVE by theorem, not cost-to-simulate.
_rationale.repeated_shots_fixed_randomness: YES by design: 25,000 Bell shots per rung on copies of one sealed-P eigenstate. The problem instance IS the fixed state; the single-copy floor is stated over ANY adaptive single-copy strategy on that same state, so the F119 delivered-easy leak (per-qubit determinism within a row leaking a per-copy secret) has no analogue — there is no per-copy secret. F122 survived this exact question at court.
_rationale.hardness_argued_on_ideal: The floor is evaluated at the DELIVERED eps_del measured on the flown rung (not the design eps); r(n) uses measured eps_size and eps_del per rung (registration item 1-4, k=4 position draws).
_rationale.baseline_shots_assumed: Theorem floor; no assumed shot count.
_rationale.baseline_denied_speedups: The bound is over all adaptive single-copy strategies; nothing is denied.
_rationale.no_problem_specific_search: Not applicable to an information-theoretic floor over the whole single-copy class; recorded as 'no' because the floor is the systematic answer, not because a search was skipped.
_rationale.arms_billed_in_different_units: Both arms in COPIES of the state.
_rationale.stopping_rules_differ_or_unit_unfrozen: Registered fixed-copies design (--copies 50000) frozen 08-30 before any P1 rung; floor evaluated at delivered eps by the frozen rule.
